title: Relationship and Goal Bonus Yield Parameters by Savings Tier
content:
Two bonus yield parameters sit above the base yield of Savings & Money Market Accounts, and both are set tier by tier. The relationship bonus is stated in percentage points added to the base annual percentage yield when the customer holds a qualifying checking tier, and carries a cap on the combined savings balance, across all of the customer's savings accounts, on which it is paid. The goal bonus is stated in percentage points added for a cycle in which the goal conditions are met, with a minimum figure for net deposits in the cycle and a cap on the daily balance it is paid on. A goal bonus of 0.00 percent means the tier does not offer it.

| Tier | Relationship bonus | Qualifying checking tiers | Relationship bonus balance cap | Goal bonus | Minimum net deposits in the cycle | Goal bonus balance cap |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Starter Savings | 0.00 percentage points | none | 0.00 USD | 0.00 percent | not offered | not offered |
| Statement Savings | 0.05 percentage points | Everyday Checking, Interest Checking, Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | 25000.00 USD | 0.00 percent | not offered | not offered |
| Goal Builder Savings | 0.10 percentage points | Everyday Checking, Interest Checking, Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | 25000.00 USD | 1.75 percent | 50.00 USD | 25000.00 USD |
| Money Market Account | 0.15 percentage points | Interest Checking, Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | 100000.00 USD | 0.00 percent | not offered | not offered |
| Premier Money Market | 0.25 percentage points | Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | 250000.00 USD | 0.00 percent | not offered | not offered |
| Private Client Money Market | 0.25 percentage points | Private Client Checking | 1000000.00 USD | 0.00 percent | not offered | not offered |

### Distinctions between the tiers

Starter Savings is the only tier whose relationship bonus parameter is 0.00 percentage points and whose qualifying checking list reads none; its balance cap is accordingly 0.00 USD.

The list of qualifying checking tiers narrows as the savings tier rises: four checking tiers qualify a Statement Savings or Goal Builder Savings account, three qualify a Money Market Account, two qualify a Premier Money Market account, and only Private Client Checking qualifies a Private Client Money Market account.

Goal Builder Savings is the only tier of Savings & Money Market Accounts that offers the goal bonus, at 1.75 percentage points, on net deposits in the cycle of at least 50.00 USD and on daily balance up to 25000.00 USD.
